name: KromiumSearch
summary: Facade for managing in-page text search operations within a browser instance.

methods.name: find
methods.signature: fun find(searchText: String, forward: Boolean = true, matchCase: Boolean = false, findNext: Boolean = false)
methods.description: Searches for searchText within the currently loaded web page.

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: The text string to search for.

parameters.name: forward
parameters.description: Whether to search forward (true) or backward (false).

parameters.name: matchCase
parameters.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive.

parameters.name: findNext
parameters.description: Whether this is a continuation of a previous search.

methods.name: stopFinding
methods.description: Stops the current search operation and optionally clears search highlighting.

parameters.name: clearSelection
parameters.description: Whether to clear the active selection highlighting.
